name: Brown's | Avenue Hotel
description:
Set on a side street, this upscale adults-only hotel is 5 minutes on foot from Avenida metro station, 3 km from São Jorge Castle and 12 km from Dafundo Beach.
Polished rooms have Wi-Fi, TVs and safes, as well as minibars, Nespresso machines and rainfall showers. Suites add separate living spaces and free-standing tubs. Room service is offered 24/7.
Amenities include a hip library lounge and a restaurant with a terrace. There’s also a rooftop deck featuring a pool and city views. Breakfast is available.

nearby_places.name: Castelo de São Jorge
nearby_places.description: 11th-century, hilltop Moorish castle & royal residence with palace ruins & archaeological museum.

nearby_places.name: Praça do Comércio
nearby_places.description: Waterside public plaza with a notable arch & statue, lined with outdoor cafes & shopping venues.

nearby_places.name: Santa Justa Lift
nearby_places.description: Cast-iron elevator with filigree details, built in 1902 to connect lower streets with Carmo Square.

nearby_places.name: Jerónimos Monastery
nearby_places.description: Late Gothic Manueline-style monastery housing archaeology & maritime museums in its wings.

nearby_places.name: Belém Tower
nearby_places.description: Landmark medieval fortified tower on tiny river island with rooftop terrace offering estuary views.

nearby_places.name: Lisbon Cathedral
nearby_places.description: Earthquakes have led to this cathedral being rebuilt many times in different architectural styles.

nearby_places.name: Carmo Archaeological Museum
nearby_places.description: Ruined Gothic church destroyed by an earthquake in 1755, with an evocative roofless nave & museum.

nearby_places.name: Tram 28
nearby_places.description: Classic yellow trams retaining original 1930s features like brass dials & polished wood interiors.

nearby_places.name: Museu Nacional do Azulejo
nearby_places.description: Museum of decorative azulejo tiles housed in a 16th-century monastery with a spectacular chapel.

nearby_places.name: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
nearby_places.description: This popular observation deck with a pergola offers dramatic views of Lisbon & the Tagus River.

nearby_places.name: Rua Augusta Arch
nearby_places.description: Ornate 18th-century triumphal arch with sculpted figures & views over the city center.

user_review.comment: The hotel and staff were great.  The rooms were well appointed and spotless with homey touches like interesting books.  All the things that should be included are and some that we didn't expect.

It’s not bad but it’s also really underwhelming for its price point and 5-star. The issue is just the general lack of warmth and special touches to make the experience special. At times, it almost felt like I was imposing on the place.
